import outputs.Algorithms.MuonBest
import LongTails.Setups.MuonThirdOrder

open MeasureTheory

namespace outputs.Setups.MuonThirdOrderBounded

open OracleTemplate OracleTemplate.Muon

structure Params extends outputs.Algorithms.MuonBest.Public

noncomputable abbrev spec : Setup where
  Params := Params
  Public := outputs.Algorithms.MuonBest.Public
  Instance p := Mat p.m p.n → ℝ
  Query p := Mat p.m p.n
  Reply p := Mat p.m p.n
  Output p := Mat p.m p.n
  publicInput := Params.toPublic
  valid p := 0 < p.m ∧ 0 < p.n ∧ 0 ≤ p.s ∧ 0 < p.J ∧ 0 < p.Δ ∧ 0 < p.ε
  admissible p f O :=
    LongTails.Setups.MuonThirdOrder.ThirdDerivativeBounded p.s f ∧ BddBelow (Set.range f) ∧
    f p.W0 - ⨅ W, f W ≤ p.Δ ∧
    (∀ W, LongTails.Setups.MuonThirdOrder.hessianQuadratic f W ≤ p.J) ∧
    ∀ k W seed, O.answer k (0, W) seed = gradient f W
  successful p f output _ := ∀ ω, nuclearNorm (gradient f (output ω)) ≤ p.ε
  allowedAlgorithm p A := A = outputs.Algorithms.MuonBest.algorithm p

attribute [local simp] spec

end outputs.Setups.MuonThirdOrderBounded
